tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin, normal MCV/MCH), which may be age-related or due to chronic disease. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, suggesting increased platelet size variability, possibly reflecting reactive changes. Leukocyte and other red cell indices are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended.
